title: Permanent Pond Decision
goal: Choose and purchase the permanent pond vessel that best fits the rectangular Zen design, gives the lotus a stable long-term home, and leaves permanent pump and filtration selection to Phase 3.
preferredChoice: Algreen Manhattan 40-inch Balcony Planter & Pond from Wayfair — Brownstone
decisionSummary: Phase 2 is complete. The Algreen Manhattan 40-inch Balcony Planter & Pond in Brownstone was selected over the Walmart Aquagarden and purchased from Wayfair on August 21, 2026.
whyPreferred: The clean 40 x 20 x 18-inch rectangular shape fits the planned architectural Zen pond design better than the more traditional pond-kit appearance.
Wayfair lists the Manhattan for use as an above-ground water garden, with durable rotomolded outdoor construction.
The Manhattan vessel can be paired with a separately selected Phase 3 pump, mechanical filtration and biological filtration instead of being locked into bundled equipment.
The Manhattan vessel was less expensive than the Walmart Aquagarden kit at the time of the decision, leaving more room in the project budget for the filtration system we actually want.
The overall visual design was the deciding factor: the Manhattan looks more like an intentional rectangular garden feature and better supports the planned jasmine, lotus and Buddha composition.
